notes.title: Update 1.07 is now polished!
notes.notes:
Since the release a few days ago, I have vastly improved stability with a fix to the Audio plugin. Since then I have been unable to cause it to crash. This issue had been around for the past 6 months so its great that I finally found a fix for it!
I have also added the following improvements:
•	Oculus controllers no longer wobble
•	Improved Lazer Light in menu
•	Improved Rock texture detail
•	Improved Music Visualization Effects
•	Visualization Intensity Slider has a greater effect
•	Desktop Mode hints only play on your first run of the game
•	Fixed Torch
•	Sped up tutorial voice acting pauses for Oculus Rift
Now the update 4.07 is polished, I will be releasing it on all other download platforms.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Latest Update 1.07 Released
notes.notes:
Due to a series of complications with the Unreal Engine, the latest update has taken a while to complete, but I have just successfully upgraded the engine to the latest version (4.18), which solves a number of issues with the game.
•	The framerate has been vastly improved.
•	The menu system has had a complete overhaul.
•	The flying system now uses rocket thrusters attached to your hands.
•	The Ringed planet now has ten-thousand physical asteroids circling it.
•	The intro Room and Tutorial have been updated with a new Voice Actor.
•	The inability to use the 'Backspace' and button within the VR music browser has been fixed.
•	A game-breaking error with using the Xbox controller has been remedied.
•	Thumbsticks & Thumbpads now have digital sensitivity instead of analogue.
•	A Web Browser has been added to Desktop mode for easy playing of music.
•	Improved Music Visualization effects, and more!
Rather than fix other minor bugs that were produced with the update, I have chosen to release it for Steam first as I know many of you will be downloading it as I sleep and I’d rather you have a more stable version of the game. I will be continuing to update the game with minor fixes over the next few days, so if you come across any more bugs, please wait 1 day before messaging me as I may have it fixed by then.
I hope you enjoy the latest instalment of the Space Dream Demo!

notes.title: Space Dream VR Demo 1.06 now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The Space Dream VR Demo 1.06 is now available for download.

It includes the following:

- VR Rotation now auto-aligns with where you face when changing areas.
- Improved torch
- Improved object collision
- Prevented rotation flickering
- Added Extra Teleportation sphere that takes the player to the galaxy.
- Minor artwork improvements such as adding more particles and improving textures.
- Fixed numerous Tutorial Bugs
- Fixed the ‘Switch to VR’ Button.
- Control Hints not showing after switched to Desktop
